text:
maria: Hey team — spotted a ~1.8% exact-match drop on IRQA when turning on AWQ-int8 prefetch + continuous-batching in the canary. Anyone else see this?

ton y: I reproduced it on canary too. Quick grep of logs shows repeated stale prefix cache hits for AWQ shards. Example: 
```
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z WARN Prefetch stale prefix hit mismatch model=redwood-7b-v2-awq quant=awq-int8 shard=3 prefix_hash=0x9f4a... expected_seq=128 actual_seq=64
```

alex: Can you paste the run id and the runtime config you used?
maria: run_id=run-2123-canary-07, config: ```{
  "batching":"continuous",
  "prefetch":true,
  "kv_cache_ttl_ms":300000,
  "quant_profile":"awq-int8",
  "gpu":"a100-80g",
  "model":"redwood-7b-v2-awq"
}```
sam: Quick numbers from the canary eval — p50 latency +2ms, tokens/sec +3%, but eval dropped: baseline EM=86.2 -> AWQ-int8+prefetch+contbatch EM=84.4. NLL shift +0.25 on dev set. :thinking:
tony: Hypothesis: continuous batch coalescing is pulling prefetched KV entries that were generated under a different quant configuration (or prefix length). AWQ relies on per-layer scale metadata; if the cache key doesn't include quant_tag or kv_version we can serve mismatched KV that slightly perturbs logits.
alex: Proposed immediate mitigation: include quant_tag (and optionally prefix_len) in KV keying and introduce kv_version. E.g.:
```python
kv_key = sha256(prefix_bytes + model_id.encode() + quant_tag.encode() + str(kv_version).encode())
```
maria: That makes sense. Any rollout plan suggestions?
anna: Also consider that continuous batching mixes short contexts with long ones; if prefix warmup differs, the cached KV can be stale for long-context inference. Including prefix_length in the key or using a per-prefix TTL helps.
eval-bot: automated-eval: run-2123-canary-07 baseline_EM=86.2 | awq_int8_prefetch_contbatch_EM=84.4 | delta=-1.8
tony: Two mitigations we should try in parallel: A) kv-namespace per-quant_profile (cheap to toggle) B) kv_version bump + include prefix_len in keying (more robust). Also add fast fallback to full-precision KV compute if cache_hit_confidence < 0.9.
alex: Note tradeoffs: per-quant namespaces blow up cache size. Command to change namespace: `redwoodctl model update --model redwood-7b-v2-awq --cache_namespace quant_awq_v2`
sam: I'll add instrumentation to capture cache hit/miss rates broken down by namespace + quant_profile + prefix_len and tag evals. We should track hit_staleness_count too.
maria: I'll kick off two experiments: (1) namespace=quant_awq_v2, (2) kv_version=2 + include prefix_len in key. Kicking off now, cc @eng-runtime. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary policy updated for redwood-7b-v2-awq — cache_namespace=quant_awq_v2, batch_group_by=quant_tag+prefix_len
eng-runtime: Reminder — add eviction policy when creating namespaces. Suggested: LRU + per-namespace size cap and TTL=10m to limit blowup.
alex: Also add a regression gate on exact-match; block rollout if delta < -0.5% on critical evals.
maria: Thanks all — I'll post results when the runs finish. :thumbsup:
